user.title: Connect to a Brilliant panel
user.description: Enter the panel's address and its SSH login. The password is only sent after you have confirmed the panel's SSH host key (trust on first use).

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the panel.
data_description.expected_fingerprint: Paste the panel's SHA256 or MD5 host key fingerprint to verify it up front (ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub on the panel) and skip the confirmation step.

install.title: Install the kiosk
install.description: The kiosk is not installed on this panel. Home Assistant can install the latest stable release with ha-kiosk-setup. Create a long-lived access token (profile page) for the panel and paste it here. {error}

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the panel

data_description.install: Untick to add the panel for monitoring only.
data_description.ha_url: An address the panel can reach on your network.
data_description.mqtt_host: The panel publishes its entities here (built-in kiosk MQTT).
data_description.mqtt_password: Leave empty to reuse Home Assistant's own MQTT login when the user matches it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the panel password
reauth_confirm.description: The SSH password for {host} was rejected.

data_description.host: The new address must reach the same panel (same SSH host key).

host_key.title: Confirm the panel host key
host_key.description:
The panel at {host} presented this SSH host key fingerprint:

`{fingerprint}`

Compare it with the key on the panel before continuing. Submitting pins this key; the SSH password is only sent to a panel that presents it.

error.host_key_mismatch: The panel's SSH host key does not match the pinned key.
error.invalid_value: A value is not allowed in kiosk.env: {error}

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different panel.
abort.host_key_changed: The panel at the new address presents a different SSH host key than the pinned one. Verify the panel, then remove and add it again to trust the new key.

progress.installing: Downloading and installing the kiosk on the panel. This can take a few minutes (the panel restarts its display services).

init.title: Brilliant Kiosk options
init.description: MQTT is never switched off: the panel always publishes its entities, either with the kiosk's built-in MQTT or through brilliant-mqtt.

data_description.mqtt_device_id: Required for brilliant-mqtt (MQTT_DEVICE_ID in kiosk.env): the kiosk's entities join that device.
data_description.manage_installs: Allow installing, updating and rolling back the kiosk from Home Assistant. Off by default when brilliant-mqtt manages the panel.

error.device_id_required: Enter the brilliant-mqtt device id (letters, digits, - and _).

abort.not_loaded: The panel is not connected right now.

invalid_auth.message: The panel rejected the SSH password.

host_key_mismatch.message: The panel's SSH host key changed: {error}

checksum_mismatch.message: The bundle did not match its checksum: {error}

release_error.message: Could not fetch the kiosk release: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No Brilliant Kiosk panel with config entry id {entry_id}.

mqtt_cannot_be_disabled.message: KIOSK_MQTT cannot be switched off or removed: the panel must always publish over MQTT.

nothing_to_change.message: Give at least one value to set or one key to delete.

installs_not_managed.message: Install management is off for this panel. Turn on "Manage installs" in its options.

setup_busy.message: The panel is busy running ha-kiosk-setup: {error}

voice_not_in_wyoming.title: Voice satellite is not set up in Home Assistant
voice_not_in_wyoming.description: The panel at {host} runs the voice satellite (KIOSK_VOICE=1), but Home Assistant has no Wyoming entry for it. Add the Wyoming Protocol integration with this host, or set KIOSK_VOICE=0.

host_key_changed.title: The panel SSH host key changed
host_key_changed.description: The panel at {host} now presents the SSH host key {fingerprint}, which does not match the pinned key. Connections are refused until you verify the panel (it may have been reset, or something else answers on that address). If the change is expected, remove the panel and add it again to trust the new key.

mqtt_provider_not_applied.title: The MQTT provider could not be applied
mqtt_provider_not_applied.description: Changing the MQTT provider of {host} needs a settings change on the panel, which failed: {error}. Save the options again once the panel is reachable.

set_env.name: Set settings
set_env.description: Merges settings into the panel's kiosk.env. KIOSK_MQTT cannot be switched off.

values.name: Values
values.description: Settings to set (KEY: value). Quotes, backslash, $ and backtick are not allowed in values.

restart.name: Restart kiosk
restart.description: Restart the kiosk service after writing.

get_env.name: Get settings
get_env.description: Returns the effective settings (kiosk.env plus runtime overrides, secrets masked).

bus_get.name: Read bus variables
bus_get.description: Reads the variables of a Brilliant message-bus peripheral.

bus_set.name: Write bus variables
bus_set.description: Writes externally settable variables of a message-bus peripheral.

logs.name: Get logs
logs.description: Returns the last journal lines of a kiosk service.

install_version.name: Install version
install_version.description: Installs a specific kiosk release with ha-kiosk-setup.

tag.name: Release tag
tag.description: The GitHub release tag, for example v1.4.0.
